title: Sylvia Sanchez, Nour Hooshmand display Pinay pride at Busan film fest
summary: Veteran actress and producer Sylvia Sanchez represented the production company at the festival's opening ceremonies, walking the red carpet with the cast and creative team of the Filipino film "Ria."
